ai_briefing.headline: Actively exploited Acronis flaw, WordPress plugin backdoor, and major Oracle patch update
ai_briefing.narrative: An actively exploited Acronis vulnerability in its cPanel backup plugin requires immediate attention. Additionally, a malicious WordPress plugin has backdoored numerous sites, necessitating urgent review and remediation. Organizations should also prioritize applying Oracle's extensive September Critical Security Patch Update to address 672 CVEs.
takeaways: Prioritize patching for the Acronis cPanel backup plugin due to potential active exploitation.
Immediately identify and remediate compromised WordPress sites using the malicious Admin Menu Editor Pro plugin.
Apply the Oracle September Critical Security Patch Update to address 672 CVEs across affected products.
Review and patch Cisco Secure Email Gateway if affected by the flaw added to CISA's KEV catalog.
watch_items: Monitor for further details or exploitation patterns related to the Acronis vulnerability.
Observe for additional compromises or remediation guidance concerning the malicious WordPress plugin.
Track any new developments regarding the Cisco Secure Email Gateway flaw.
